column1: Clause  2  :  This  clause  amends  section  5A  of  the  High  Court  of  the  Provinces  (Special
Provisions)  Act,  No.  19  of  1990,  and  the  legal  effect  of  the  amendment  is  to  enable  the
High  Court  of  the  Provinces  to  hear  the  appeals  from  the  Small  Claims  Court.
